connection_condition: player_attribute_snapshot rows reference the player through tab01.fld003 to tab02.fld003; tab01.fld002 to tab02.fld002 is an alternative identifier path
description: A player's ability history is composed of dated attribute snapshots; a snapshot cannot exist without its player.
A team's style history is composed of dated team-attribute snapshots; a snapshot cannot exist without its team.
A country is composed of the leagues played in it; a league cannot exist without its country.
A league season is composed of its matches; a match cannot exist without a league.

connection_condition: tab07.fld078 holds the home team FIFA-API identifier, corresponding to tab05.fld049
description: The home side is a component of a match and exists only within that match.

connection_condition: tab07.fld079 holds the away team FIFA-API identifier, corresponding to tab05.fld049
description: The away side is a component of a match and exists only within that match.
The home team's goal count is a component of the match record.
The away team's goal count is a component of the match record.

connection_condition: a team participates in a match through either of the two team references in the match row (tab07.fld078 for home, tab07.fld079 for away), both corresponding to tab05.fld049
description: Teams participate in matches; the participation is role-dependent, so a team is not structurally composed of match rows from one column.

connection_condition: no direct player-to-team column; the link is indirect through the twenty-two player slots of a match (tab07.fld126 through tab07.fld147 to tab02.fld003) and the match's team references
description: Players and teams are associated through appearing in the same match; the database does not store a squad membership.
